text:
The most serious crime is depraved-heart murder: firing a gun at a player's leg during a crowded basketball game shows reckless indifference to an unjustifiably high risk to human life, and transferred intent applies that malice to the unintended killing of the teammate. The note is incorrect because intending only a slight wound does not reduce the mental state to mere negligence when the conduct itself is highly dangerous.  
CONFIDENCE: 88
